annotations.title: Shop coupons and promotions valid today

description: Coupon codes and promotions of compared shops, valid today, from the affiliate network eHUB (refreshed every 3 hours; never from newsletters or e-mails, never a shop on a risk list). For one country (the shop's country), the soonest ending first. Each row: the shop, `type` voucher (has a `code`) | action (no code), the advertiser's `title`, `discount` read from it (percent or amount with currency; `up_to` = "up to"; null when the text states no size of the discount, never a guess), `min_order` {amount, currency} when the text names a minimum order ("nákup nad 1 000 Kč"; it is never the discount), `valid_from`, `valid_until` (a date = the whole day), `url` the network's tracked link (Fordeal earns a commission on a purchase through it; the ranking never depends on it), `image` the card photo with `image_source` "shop_product" (a product of the shop's own offers in its main `category`) or "category" (our picture of that category; null = none, show `logo_url`), and `fetched_at` of the list. Next: find_best_price with a product name to compare the shop's prices.

country.description: Country of the shops. Default: the first compared country.
